model: Published MMDetection3D PointPillars Car, exact learned layers via verified Windows adapter
optimizer: AdamW, weight decay .01, cosine decay to 1e-6, gradient clip 10
batchnorm: pretrained running statistics frozen, affine parameters trainable
precision: bfloat16 autocast, float32 losses and parameters
intensity: fourth channel fixed to zero for every railway cloud; XYZ-only comparison
geometry: 0.16m XY pillars; expanded 160m range, padded Y +/-40.32m, Z support [-5,8], original pretrained VFE vertical center reference -1m preserved; TRAIN-only ground alignment to -1.6m
assignment: nearest-BEV IoU positive .6, negative .45; force best anchors for each GT at IoU >=.1 to cover narrow/large road vehicles
test_policy: All three fine-tunes finish before any test inference. Same validation AP50 then AP25 selection; additionally fixed final epoch. Same known diagnostic fold, not fresh blind evaluation.
supervision_limit: synthetic_coverage uses real TRAIN annotation shape/support priors; it is real-informed simulation augmentation, not zero-real-data training
